Example.title: Task demo
Example.description: A small removable feature: the server validates the input, the browser shows the result.
Example.temporaryDescription: Tasks you add stay on this page only. Refreshing restores the initial state. Nothing is stored and the list is not shared.
Example.listDescription: The server loaded the initial tasks. Only you see your changes.
Example.emptyDescription: Start by adding the first task.
Example.formDescription: Try adding a task, validation, and a safe failure.
Example.textHint: Enter 1 to {max} characters. Spaces alone are not enough.
Example.simulateHint: Turn the simulation off to submit the same task again.
Example.errorTitle: The task could not be added

errors.INVALID_INPUT: Check the form. The text needs 1 to 120 characters and cannot be spaces only.
errors.DEMO_FAILURE: This is a demo failure. Turn off the failure simulation and submit the task again.
errors.UNAVAILABLE: The server could not be reached. Try submitting the task again.
